name: SLHS 6371
title: Seminar in Professional Skills for Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
description: Preparation for academic and industry careers in speech, language, and hearing sciences, including grant-writing, service duties such as reviewing, scientific ethics and rigor, and mentorship.
requirement_description: Instructor consent. Not open for credit to students who have taken SLHS 6367 when offered as "Graduate Survival Skills for Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences."
